Frontier ML tasks
	

🌐 Website | ⚓ Harbor Hub
Data for the tasks in induction-labs/frontier-ml.
Each task has one folder:
<slug>/public/     given to the coding agent verbatim, at /task/public
<slug>/private/    held-out data for the trusted verifier, at /tests/private
<slug>/artifacts/  optional starting files for the agent, at /artifacts
<slug>/manifest.json  optional provenance summary

Tasks pin this repository by commit in tasks/<slug>/task.yaml. Starting model weights are… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/inductionlabs/frontier-ml-tasks.
